level00.imageAlt: Archaeological excavation camp in the desert
level00.captionInitial: You have arrived at the excavation camp.
level00.captionCompleted: The first IRIS signal has been detected.
level00.title: Tartessos Quest
level00.paragraph1: An archaeological expedition has discovered a sealed entrance beneath the desert sands. Everything suggests it leads to the remains of Tartessos.
level00.paragraph2: Inside, there is no ordinary treasure, but a data technology impossible for its age: InterSystems IRIS.
level00.paragraph3: Your mission is to unravel its mysteries by overcoming the trials that protect each fragment of Atlantean knowledge.
level00.paragraph4: ObjectScript, classes, SQL, REST, JSON, Embedded Python, and globals will be the keys to revealing the true power of IRIS.
level00.successParagraph1: The Tartessos Quest web application has been successfully deployed with Docker.
level00.successParagraph2: The camp is established, and the expedition can access the first level of the Atlantean archive.
level00.hint: Next mission: connect this interface to the technology discovered at the core of InterSystems IRIS.
